test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 1991, the Indian rupee was devalued in how many steps?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Twice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian rupee had two rounds of devaluation in 1991, beginning on **July 1 and ending on July 3.**
 
• Indian Rupee was devalued for the third time in 1991.
 
 
• The devaluation procedure in 1991 was carried out in two steps on July 1 and July 3.
 
• The year 1991 is often cited as the year of economic reform in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• ** In total Indian rupee **was devalued **three times**, as per the question in **1991 Indian rupee was devalued twice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Reserve Bank of India issues currency notes in India.
 
• The Indian rupee became an independent currency with the establishment of RBI in 1935.
 
• Reserve Bank of India issues all currency notes above one rupee.
 
• Indian Rupee was devalued in three instances but four times.
 
• Indian Rupee was devalued for the **first time in 1949.**
 
• Indian Rupee was devalued for the **second time in 1966__.**
 
 
• India’s war with Pakistan in late 1965 played a key role in the 1966 devaluation.
 
• It was the result of the first major financial crisis the government faced.
 
• Inflation had caused Indian prices to become much higher than world prices at the pre-devaluation exchange rate.
 
• There was foreign pressure on India to reform its economy.
